Tuition and Fees

Example School is committed to keeping an exceptional education within reach of committed families. Tuition covers the full academic programme, textbooks, co-curricular activities, and daily lunch. A one-time enrollment deposit is credited against the first tuition installment.

Grade LevelAnnual Tuition (2026-2027)
All Grades (K-12)$45,000
New Student Enrollment Deposit$5,000
Technology and Activity Fee$225

Families may choose a one-payment, two-payment, or ten-payment plan. Need-based financial assistance is available at every grade; more than one million dollars in aid is awarded annually. Contact the Enrolment Office to learn more about payment schedules and assistance deadlines.
